reason: Reproduced with installed uv 0.12.13 on four-CPU Linux x86_64, Python 3.12.3. Created 54 workspace packages requiring hatchling and hatch-vcs, then ran `uv --no-config build --all-packages --python /usr/bin/python --index-url http://127.0.0.1:PORT/simple -v` with a fresh UV_CACHE_DIR. The local index delayed wheel response headers by three seconds. After sending all ten wheels, uv remained stuck for 370.67 seconds, exceeding the default five-minute lock timeout: 530 lock-wait messages, 514 threads including 512 blocked on file locks, no backend children, artifacts, or timeout error. The process required external termination. A 52-package control completed in 16 seconds; the 54-package public-PyPI baseline completed in 14 seconds. The reporter’s exact uv 0.12.23 binary was not tested. Updated $RUNNER_TEMP/issue-context/README.md with reproduction details and test-coverage gaps.
